result.summary: All nine outputs coherently complete their bounded draft/review task under the adjudicated rubric. No located correction requiring an output repair was identified. This is descriptive artifact evidence, not a superiority, implementation-verification or operational-acceptance claim.

shared_limits: Only one output per case was reviewed. Multiple cases share each participant context and are correlated.
The cases and rubrics are public, the producer environment is instruction-separated rather than a securely held-out sandbox, and effective inherited exposure is not independently reconstructed.
